description: This Go source file implements a dynamic certificate and key content provider for Kubernetes, capable of watching certificate files for changes, reloading them, and notifying listeners.

classes.name: DynamicCertKeyPairContent
classes.description: A provider that dynamically loads TLS certificate and key files, watches for changes, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: NewDynamicServingContentFromFiles
methods.description: Creates a new DynamicCertKeyPairContent instance from specified certificate and key files.

methods.name: AddListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to be notified when the certificate content changes.

methods.name: loadCertKeyPair
methods.description: Loads and validates the certificate and key files, updating internal state if changed.

methods.name: RunOnce
methods.description: Performs a single load and validation of the certificate and key files.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller, watching files and handling reloads until context is canceled.

methods.name: watchCertKeyFile
methods.description: Watches the certificate and key files for changes using fsnotify, triggering reloads.

methods.name: handleWatchEvent
methods.description: Handles filesystem events to restart watches on file removal or renaming, and triggers reloads.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Processes queued work items to reload certificates.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Processes the next item in the work queue, attempting to reload certificates.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the identifier name of the provider.

methods.name: CurrentCertKeyContent
methods.description: Returns the current certificate and key byte slices.
